questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed. You cannot turn around and go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to remind you to slow down, be careful, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Activate your turn signal and proceed into traffic at the usual speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign means you must let traffic on the main road pass before entering. You don't need to stop completely if no traffic is coming, but always slow down and enter carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs show you are in or near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and follow the speed limit signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign shows you are near a school. Be ready to stop if children are crossing in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs alert drivers to school zones. Some show where children or pedestrians may cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped warning signs tell you about conditions just ahead. A speed number on the sign shows the safe speed for that area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means drivers driving slower than others should stay in the right lane to let faster traffic pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction and maintenance work areas. They help drivers and pedestrians stay safe. Traffic fines may be doubled in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, and go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped signs warn of possible danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of danger in or near work areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to possible hazards. This sign warns that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign marks a railroad crossing. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look and listen for trains, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn carts, and farm equipment display this emblem. It warns other drivers that the vehicle will travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped warning signs alert drivers to hazards. Orange-colored signs warn of construction or maintenance work ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. When a bicyclist extends their left arm straight out, they are signaling a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of low clearance. It shows the distance from the road surface to the bottom of a bridge or overpass, such as 12 feet 6 inches.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic traveling the same direction will soon combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards. This sign means the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that the road splits ahead and you must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a change in the road direction or that the road is narrowing. You may see these signs on sharp curves or approaching narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that a divided highway begins ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is displayed on slow-moving vehicles to warn other drivers.
